# --- not in audit §9.1: pre-existing stock property we must not regress ----
# This is not a PPS property. It is what produced the measured 27 W and it is
# already live on the device; leaving it at the stock 2000 would *regress* the
# image. Audit §9.1 scopes itself to PPS, so its absence there is expected.
# Delete this line if a strictly §9.1-only payload is ever wanted.
qcom,pd_input_current_charger_ma=5000

# --- PD (buck) path limits: the stock table only allows 2 A of battery current,
# which caps every fast-charge mode at ~17 W. Raised here for the PPS path.
qcom,pd_temp_normal_fastchg_current_ma=5000
qcom,pd_temp_little_cool_fastchg_current_ma=5000
qcom,pd_temp_cool_fastchg_current_ma_high=4000

qcom,pd_temp_little_cold_fastchg_current_ma_high=2000
qcom,pd_temp_little_cold_fastchg_current_ma_low=1600

# --- non-PD fast-charge current table (this is the one actually applied: the
# stock values are all 1100 mA, which is exactly the ~1.0 A battery current we
# measured at 11 V). The pd_temp_* table above is only used after
